hero.title: Foreign Judgment Recognition
hero.subtitle: Guidance and support for individuals who need to have a foreign court judgment recognized for legal or administrative purposes in another country.

assistance.title: What We Can Assist With
assistance.subtitle: We provide guidance on the documentation, formalities, and procedures that may be required when seeking recognition of a foreign judgment.

documentation.title: Judgment & Supporting Documents
documentation.description: Assistance identifying and organizing the foreign judgment and supporting documentation required for the recognition process.

authentication.title: Authentication & Legalization
authentication.description: Guidance on apostille, legalization, authentication, and other formalities that may be required for foreign documents.

translations.title: Certified Translations
translations.description: Guidance regarding certified or official translation requirements when documents need to be submitted in another language.

recognitionProcedures.title: Recognition Procedures
recognitionProcedures.description: Support in understanding the applicable recognition procedures and documentation required by the relevant authority or court.
